The background is highly chaotic and surreal, featuring a distorted, semi-transparent blue structure that looks like a melting vending machine or kiosk with garbled text and internal mechanical/electronic components visible through a 'glass' layer. There is a yellow cable connecting the white device to the background structure. An orange, amorphous blob is visible inside the transparent casing in the background.
